risk.edge_size_note: **2026-10-30 根治移除 0.35 掩蔽权重:** 此前 ACCEPT|LONG 净亏(-15.37U)的根因是 structure.py 一刀切丢弃了 FLIPPED_BOX_EDGE,导致「跌破平衡箱挖坑后重新向上突破进入平衡箱」的真多头突破被全部拦掉,只剩下箱顶追涨。补齐 box_reentry_enabled(突破进入平衡箱)后,ACCEPT|LONG 在 1.0 原生权重下直接由 -15.37U 翻正至 +81.01U(全策略 dev +249.02 / test +145.17 / full +520.70 / 去Top10 +148.40 / 1.5x +258.98 五项全优),故彻底清空 0.35 权重补丁。

limitations: Production canonical campaigns, not a tick-by-tick execution of live_runner.
Fixed four-symbol universe; no historical dynamic universe, outages or API failures.
Live daily-loss/order-rate circuit breakers are not simulated by run_campaigns.
Slippage is embedded in fill prices; do not deduct slippage_cost twice.
Tail removal is attribution of original trades, not a counterfactual recompounding replay.
dev/test are independent 300-USDT starts, not additive portions of full compounded PnL.
